frozen_scope: This isUR1c1only: one existing-renderer-owned prepared-body service for currently prepared consumers (navigation and retained ink layers), plus bounded identity/content lookup and source-retention hot-hit work. It is not fullUR1c completion.

Evolve existing PreparedGeometryCache/SourceRetentionPool; no parallel cache/document owner, global cross-document store, SDK/API/schema or Brush algorithm. Existing canonical/transient callers that already use retained ink preparation must consume the shared service. Ordinary cooperative canonical/Direct first-use integration is explicitUR1c2, not silently called complete.

Prepared bodies are world immutable geometry; transform, permanent/active masks, viewport, device pixels and object ownership remain separate. Equivalent bodies can share CPU geometry only; independent object pixels/masks/source identities remain valid.

Fast identity requires immutable ownership/incarnation, command discriminator and aliased pointee identity or an equally strong verified proof. Naked addresses/ObjectId/length/incomplete legacy digest are insufficient. Same owner with different aliased payloads must not be conflated.

Different allocation equal content may share only after complete equality verification; fingerprints are lookup indexes, not authority. Hash/collision/content validation occurs on admission or changed identity, not every warm request. No hidden semantic canonical encoding on each frame.

Source bytes can use a proven immutable known footprint on repeated identity; arbitrary alias/type/size changes retain full admission validation. Source retention charges each actual retained allocation once and index/alias metadata is bounded/charged under existing quotas.

No new monolithic full-history preparation in input callbacks/frame work. Existing prepared compilation/replay behavior is preserved in this slice; do not call synchronous get/build from additional ordinary canonical leaves. Mutable replay scratch stays owner-thread only.

Only the existing Renderer clears the shared service on its declared reset/budget-lifetime boundary. A consumer releases its own references/discoverability without invalidating another active consumer; leases pin in-use data. No unbounded aliases or cache-only references that make LRU permanently unevictable.
UR1b execution/actual-target/Direct rules and32/96MiB/default per-entry limits remain. UR2staysquarantined; immediate nextDown/navigation/History/Scene/overlay work is forbidden.
